senses.gloss: cicca, or ciccha, m., a kind of malevolent supernatural being: Mvy 〔4377〕 ciccha, in Index var. cicca; Mironov cicca, v.l. ciccha; follows kākhorda and vetāla, followed by preṣaka; = Tib. sems (b)sgyur ba (?); in similar lists of evil spirits, cicca Māy 〔220.18〕; 〔245.16〕.
Cicchaka, var. for Śīrṣaka, n. of a nāga king, q.v.: Mvy 〔3283〕; Mironov Cicchaka, v.l. Śīrṣaka.
